name: Should I sell my home first or buy a new one first?

mainEntity.name: Should I sell my home first or buy a new one first?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to sell first or buy first depends on your financial stability, risk tolerance, and local market conditions. Selling first eliminates the risk of carrying two mortgages but might require temporary housing. Buying first offers a seamless move but carries financial risk. A practical tradeoff is balancing financial certainty with convenience; selling first provides more financial clarity, while buying first offers less disruption to your living situation. Consider your personal financial comfort with potential overlap in expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: The choice depends on your finances and risk tolerance; selling first offers financial certainty but may require temporary housing, while buying first offers convenience but financial risk.
